# TG Validator Telegram bulk username profile check
> Official asynchronous integration for `tg_username_profile_batch`.

## Resources
- Product: https://tgvalidator.com/products/tg_username_profile_batch
- API documentation: https://tgvalidator.com/api-docs
- Repository: https://github.com/tgvalidator/telegram-bulk-username-profile-api
- Registration: https://tgvalidator.com/register?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=tgvalidator_telegram-bulk-username-profile-api
- Pricing: https://tgvalidator.com/pricing
- OpenAPI: openapi.yaml

## Contract
- Base URL: https://tgvalidator.com; authentication: X-API-Key.
- Submit POST /api/v1/bulk-tasks with service_type=tg_username_profile_batch, then file. The response field remains data.product.
- Input: username, 1000–500000 valid entries. No country field is required.
- Poll GET /api/v1/bulk-tasks/{id} at least 30 seconds apart. Status: processing, success, failed. A successful task may carry result_url; a missing link is a reason to query again, not resubmit.
- Result columns, in order: identifier, activated, uid, activedays, avatar_url.
- Processing counters are provisional while preparing=true. Final success/failure counts only appear after success.
- No pricing/reservation quote is returned by the public API. Read current pricing separately.
- Use Idempotency-Key for a retry of the same submission; never blindly resubmit after an uncertain timeout.
- Example input files are format fixtures, not valid production-sized batches.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-30.
